The branch records orphaned tool results by call ID during chat-item coalescing and merges a later-sorted matching tool call into the earlier result, with native-runtime regression tests.

PR surface: Source +24, Tests +91. Total +115 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. —source inspection gives a high-confidence path: order one or more `toolResult` items before an assistant message containing multiple linked tool calls, then observe that the single-ID guard prevents backward pairing.

target.title: fix(ui): pair tool calls with earlier-sorted orphan results in chat coalescing
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

For native-runtime transcripts (`anthropic-messages`), Control UI tool cards render only the "Tool output" section — the "Tool input" section never appears even though the tool call's `arguments` are present in the stored transcript.

## Why This Change Was Made

The root cause: `buildChatItems` orders items by timestamp. In native-runtime transcripts the persisted result's timestamp can precede the assistant call message's timestamp, so the result sorts before its call. `coalesceToolActivityMessages` scans forward only — a result seen before any registered call becomes an orphan, and when the call message arrives later nothing looks back.

Fix: track orphaned results by call id (`openResultIndexes`), and when an assistant message with that single unresolved call id arrives later, merge backward into the result's timeline slot.

## Changes

- **`ui/src/pages/chat/chat-thread.ts`** — track orphaned tool results by call id; merge backward when the call arrives later
- **`ui/src/pages/chat/chat-thread.native-tool-input.test.ts`** — 4 new tests covering call+result as separate messages, toolMessages delivery, earlier-result timestamp, and out-of-order listing

## Evidence (2026-07-19 refresh)

### Full regression suite (127 tests, 3 files)

```
$ npx vitest run ui/src/pages/chat/chat-thread.native-tool-input.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-thread.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-thread.question.test.ts

 ✓ ui/src/pages/chat/chat-thread.native-tool-input.test.ts (4 tests)
 ✓ ui/src/pages/chat/chat-thread.test.ts (118 tests)
 ✓ ui/src/pages/chat/chat-thread.question.test.ts (5 tests)

 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  127 passed (127)
```

### New tests detail

```
 ✓ renders both input and output when call and result are separate messages
 ✓ renders both input and output when the result arrives via toolMessages
 ✓ renders both input and output when the result timestamp precedes the call
 ✓ renders both input and output when the result is listed before the call
```

### Control-red (before fix)

The 4th test ("result timestamp precedes the call") was added to reproduce the exact failure before the fix was applied. It passes now that orphaned results are tracked backward.

### Mantis proof request

A maintainer can dispatch the Mantis capture for visual Control UI proof:

```
@openclaw-mantis web UI chat proof: verify and capture a native-runtime tool call whose expanded Control UI card shows both Tool input and Tool output.
```
